description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Returns Joe's recent messages to the team and the team's reply to each, newest last, and the questions the team is waiting for Joe to answer. Show Joe the replies in full, word for word; a message whose state is 'open' has not been answered yet. Show every question with its number, why it matters and its choices, and tell him he can answer by typing 'answer <number>: <choice>'. When he does, pass it on with message_from_joe, kind 'answer'. Never answer a question yourself and never guess which choice he means. Read-only. A reply or a new question can take up to an hour to appear here.
name: replies_for_joe

questions.description: Questions waiting for Joe, oldest first. Empty when nothing is waiting.

title: The team's replies to Joe
